product.title: Stats vs Scouts — Basketball Decision Lab
product.summary: Weighing measured evidence against expert judgement.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students decide between what the numbers say and what a scout says on a series of player calls, then see which source was right and why neither is right every time.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Runs end-to-end and is publicly reachable. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Plays correctly, but the final round appears frozen.
knownBlockers: After locking in the Round 2 pick the button disables and no Continue appears — results only arrive when a still-running 44-second timer expires, with nothing on screen saying so. A student would reasonably assume it had crashed and reload, losing the result.

curation.tierBasis: Real historical cases that resist a single heuristic, plus a genuine value-for-money round. The final round looks frozen while a hidden timer runs out.
